glance_takeaway: This page reports results of an A/B test (Tessel Pathways onboarding, 6 weeks, 13,249 trial starters) on trial-to-paid conversion. The headline message: there is no overall winner — the overall effect (+0.8pp, p=0.16) is not significant — because the treatment's effect splits by platform: mobile-web improved strongly (+4.2pp, significant), iOS got worse (-1.9pp, significant), and Android showed no reliable effect (CI crosses zero). A non-expert would take away that two real, opposite effects cancel in the blended number, so the right conclusion is 'it depends on platform', not 'B won' or 'B lost'.

F1.note: Header chip 'Overall +0.8pp' + forest-plot title 'Δ trial-to-paid conversion'; absolute rates 11.4%/12.2% never appear anywhere on the page

F2.note: Header chip: 'CI [−0.3, +1.9] · p = 0.16 — not significant: "can't tell", not "B won"'; Overall row in forest plot is hollow/dashed crossing zero

F3.note: Partial: kicker gives '13,249 trial starters' but 184,204 randomized users and the ~50/50 split are omitted — incomplete rather than wrong

F5.note: Foot-note under forest plot: 'Platform: the only pre-registered subgroup, chosen in advance.'

F6.note: Hero card +4.2pp CI [+2.1, +6.3]; forest plot p<0.0001; caveat box notes mobile-web passes Bonferroni. Absolute rates 13.9%→18.1% absent

F7.note: Hero card −1.9pp CI [−3.6, −0.2]; p=0.027; caveat box states it fails Bonferroni (α=0.0167) but pre-registration + mechanism make it 'credible enough to act on — not proven'

F8.note: Forest plot Android row: +0.1, hollow dashed CI plotted exactly at [−1.7, +1.9], p=0.92

F9.note: 'Two real, opposite effects cancel in the blend.' under hero cards; headline 'No overall winner — the real story is a platform split'

F10.note: Novelty-decay bar chart W1–W6 labeled +2.9, +1.5, +0.6, 0.0, −0.4, +0.1 with honest 25px/pp scale; section header 'Early snapshots overstated B — novelty decay'

F11.note: Foot-note: 'Weeks 4–6: mobile-web still ≈+3.8pp, iOS still ≈−2.2pp — the split isn't novelty.'

F12.note: Guardrail tiles: '+0.2pp / 7-day retention · CI [−0.2, +0.6] / flat — pass' and '+12% → 0 / support tickets, weeks 1–2 / normalized'; absolute retention rates absent

F13.note: Tile '−38s / time-to-first-lesson · CI [−45, −31] / faster, as designed'; the trial-start-rate-flat / unbiased-denominator half is absent

F14.note: S3 bars: iOS step-3 drop-off 8.1% (A) vs 12.7% (B); foot-note explains permission ask moved to step 3 triggering the iOS system dialog, flagged 'Exploratory evidence — so: fix and re-test'; cross-platform comparison (mobile-web 3.2→3.4, Android 5.0→5.6) absent

F15.note: 'The call: narrow ship' — Mobile-web SHIP (5% holdback, 8 weeks), iOS DON'T SHIP (fix-prompt experiment ONB-2026-019), Android HOLD; SRM/diagnostics (χ² p=0.96) absent

strengths: Headline and header chip make the non-significant overall result unmissable — the brief's worst failure mode ('B won, ship everywhere') is structurally impossible to take away
Honest, verified visual encodings: forest plot, novelty bars, and drop-off bars all use true linear zero-based scales whose pixel geometry matches the stated numbers exactly
Solid-vs-hollow/dashed CI encoding (legend: 'solid = CI clear of zero · hollow = crosses zero') makes significance status visible pre-attentively
Statistical caveats are unusually faithful for an infographic: Bonferroni caveat box, 'exploratory evidence — fix and re-test' on the mechanism, 'credible enough to act on — not proven'
The narrow recommendation is rendered as an explicit three-way SHIP / DON'T SHIP / HOLD call matching the source exactly
weaknesses: No absolute conversion rates anywhere (11.4%/12.2% overall, 13.9%→18.1% mobile-web, 11.6%→9.7% iOS) — a PM cannot judge relative magnitude or sanity-check the deltas
Power/MDE context (F4: powered for +1.55pp, so +0.8pp was below detectable size) is entirely absent, weakening the 'can't tell' explanation
Randomization scale (184,204 users, 50/50) and SRM diagnostics are omitted, so trust-in-the-experiment evidence is thin
Novelty decay and the recommendation sit below the fold, so the glance conveys T1/T2 but not T3/T4
Mechanism section omits the cross-platform drop-off comparison that shows the step-3 effect is iOS-specific
evaluator_notes: Audit: 13 conveyed, 1 distorted (F3, partial sample info), 1 absent (F4), 0 contradicted. accuracy = 10 × max(0, 13 − 0)/15 = 8.7. overall = 0.35×8.7 + 0.30×6.5 + 0.15×7.5 + 0.10×7.5 + 0.10×8.0 = 7.67 → 7.7. Glance pass: T1 and T2 landed fully from the above-the-fold view; T3 (novelty) and T4 (narrow ship) were invisible at glance. Deep read is faithful and honest; main gaps are omitted absolute rates, power context, and experiment-integrity details rather than any distortion. Several 'conveyed' facts (F1, F6, F12, F13, F14, F15) are partially complete — the meaning-bearing core lands but supporting numbers are dropped; noted per fact.
